propositions: The AC1 snapshot equivalence contract test re-calls the shared composer identically across CLI/Python/MCP/reconciler surfaces instead of driving real entry points, making the test trivially pass even if surfaces stop routing through the composer

MCP and reconciler surface blocks must drive actual entry points (build_server + call_tool, and rebar_reconciler.__main__.main with argv) and capture composed snapshots through a recorder wrapping the module-global compose_operation_snapshot

Each surface assertion must anchor to absolute expected content (repo root, envelope version, config keys with distinct provenance) in addition to cross-surface comparison to discriminate from perturbations
The recorder must fire explicitly for each surface, failing with a named error if the surface composes no snapshot instead of looping silently over empty captures
